name: Sazaki
source:
A winged youth who is a member of the Himuka tribe, a bandit leader. 
He was originally a pirate but lost his boat and became a bandit, he hopes to get his boat back someday.
He has a magnanimous and chivalrous bright person.
A free spirit who is not bound by rules, he does sneaky things without batting an eyelid.

He is technically the first Suzaku of Heaven of the series.
His particular trait is "Desire".
